items.claim: two loupes on one canvas share the view id `weasel-loupe:lens`
a `font` pair conflicting with the registered HUD font only logs "failed to register default font", and the doc's "no-op" claim was wrong
items.note: I made a strict call here: `attachHud` now throws a clear error and attaches nothing. A host that wants another atlas registers it under a family of its own and passes the name. Recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: a press focuses a widget that doesn't claim `pointer`
a widget removed while hovered gets `hoverleave` after it is disposed
two loupes share one view id
items.note: duplicate of A's loupe id finding, fixed a9ffdff868

items.claim: `useLoupe`'s `source` path drops the pane region, so a pixel lens on a shared canvas reads offset pixels
a loupe window removed with `hud.remove` keeps routing input to its lens view
items.note: The lens view now routes nothing once its window is disposed, and the loupe tears down on the next frame.

items.claim: `stubHudFonts` replaces `fetch`/`createImageBitmap` with no restore, and the harness never removes its widget

items.note: The member is removed and the doc corrected; the changeset is `major`/`breaking`, since a host object literal that still sets it fails to typecheck.

items.claim: a removed widget stays in hover and open-press state
items.note: duplicate of A's hover finding, fixed 5f8dac026d. The same fix covers open presses: the next `pointerup` sweep sends no `cancel` to a widget taken off its HUD or disposed. To make that possible, `HudHit…`'s payload type `HudHitPayload` gains an optional `hud`, so that changeset is `minor` with an `api` tag.
